title: Community Conservation Award
text:
The Community Conservation Award provides funding to support locally led conservation and restoration initiatives that deliver meaningful benefits for both people and nature.
We support evidence-based projects with clearly defined objectives and measurable outcomes over a one- to two-year period. The award is particularly suited to initiatives that translate conservation research into practical impact, pilot new approaches, or provide start-up funding to achieve lasting change.
We are especially interested in projects that:

Are led by, or developed in close partnership with, local communities
Address clearly identified conservation challenges
Demonstrate a strong evidence base and realistic pathway to impact
Deliver tangible benefits for both biodiversity and human livelihoods 

Funding is provided as a one-time award to support specific projects rather than ongoing operational expenses. Institutional overheads are not supported.
 Check out the projects we have funded so far 
We welcome conversations with individuals, foundations, and organisations who share our commitment to evidence-based conservation and community-led environmental stewardship.
